Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

panache 0.1.0

  • Added the initial Rust-backed formatter API and RStudio addins.

Breaking changes

  • expose named formatting options (dd9c15d)

Features

  • rename to format_file and format_text (75ab8f4)
  • expose named formatting options (dd9c15d)
  • configure chunk formatters with arity by default (c6ee073)
  • setup package and tests (fa1b485)

Bug fixes

  • handle formatter limits and timeouts (d4d0eac)
  • resolve symlinked paths for flavor matching (4ad4045)
